title: NMI Holdings, Inc. to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about National Mortgage Insurance Corporation's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
EMERYVILLE, Calif., May 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[NMI Holdings, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=MXwfqtf-uA3eH2fGeUOfQEHciesfg0HD5998P9P9mCWXno0osS-H6bTpWMKYjreHW86FimQq3NcD8Omzs9W2ovwW-CvaTj3aKihISujEWuc=) , (NASDAQ:NMIH) announced today that Adam Pollitzer, the company’s President and Chief Executive Officer, and Aurora Swithenbank, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will be participating at the KBW Virtual Real Estate Finance and Technology Conference on May 19th and the Truist Securities Financial Conference on May 20th in New York City. A presentation that may be referenced during the conferences will be available on the company’s website at[https://ir.nationalmi.com/investor-relations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0DoONjd1BPMKXKEor6nIPSFnZJs4tapjxuxCF7lrDjTWm7evRDh6G-DUOiMikje8NRnNyexdIKGugHMdYy1HM_9jSlvotXI1tbzsvudBVcmb6CpMms9ic23UVhUhYOKT9bVUXe3vDXFA2qNnDDi2baBs_FEoyH-AXcCmiafn7So=) .


**About NMI Holdings, Inc.**


NMI Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: NMIH) is the parent company of National Mortgage Insurance Corporation (National MI), a U.S.-based, private mortgage insurance company enabling low-down-payment borrowers to realize home ownership while protecting lenders and investors against losses related to a borrower's default. To learn more, please visit[www.nationalmi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cl8kJqBeANd3x7foGF5lf1p__GrxBB5JqeKQ0z8aCnts2kUhDrL9rXgUdfgWnXjhuqvle62PlRdKbqP-Wrwe6mTWOHijsHixpnK0fC_lcH4=) .
